conditioned_captures: Five conditioned captures (one per corrective route plus the base) ran in /dev/shm, were deleted as their rows were read, and the tmpfs was cleared at wave end. Each capture's cache key, split manifest digest, collector implementation digest and child state_dict digest are sealed in composition.corrections.captures[].
policy: Keep the composed tensor set of every child that was REVIEWED, because the frozen review is taken on those exact bytes and a dossier whose child cannot be reconstituted is not evidence. Wave 12 sealed two reviewed children and one infra row; nothing was deleted, because the infra row died before its first tensor save and has no tensor set to delete.
re_derivation: Re-run experiments/run_lfm2_matrix_composition.py from the deployment each cell receipt names in code_identity [neural-forge-matrix-4d8774f6 for COMP.MA.MXP2, -f753b9e7 for COMP.MA.MXP1; both tarballs retained under /mnt/ai_data/neural-forge-matrix/wave12/] with that cell's sealed recipe from reports/matrix-campaign-20260810/run/mxp/recipes/ on a PCI-pinned sm86 RTX 3090. Every installed tensor's sha256 is under composition.components[].installed_tensor_digests, the folded file digest under composition.composed_child_tensors_sha256, and -- for a child carrying ADDENDUM 10 routes -- every route tensor's digest under composition.corrections.routes[].route_tensor_sha256 plus the file digest under composition.corrections.corrections_tensors_sha256. A re-derivation is checkable against the seal rather than trusted.
